ententee.description: Full-stack product delivery across healthcare and robotics engagements, run in parallel with my CFD Support collaboration.
highlights: DrChrono — uplift of a US medical web app: Django/GraphQL backend, full React/TypeScript frontend rewrite.
ALF — application for a medical faculty managing attestations and trunk exams (Spring Boot, React/TS, PostgreSQL).

Internal R&D projects: edge-oriented crop-analytics vision on UAV multispectral imagery (Python/scikit-learn), a warehouse robot-swarm simulation (A*, ORCA/RVO2; Unity/C#), a human-in-the-loop route-optimization dispatch assistant (VRP with OSRM + VROOM; Django Ninja, SvelteKit), and a team-built decentralised drone-swarm early-warning simulation (PX4, Gazebo, ROS 2, Unity).

cfd-support.description: Designing and owning core C++23 modules of TCAE — a cross-platform CAE application (desktop and HPC clusters) built on OpenFOAM and ParaView/VTK.
highlights: TFEA — finite element module: CalculiX input generation and result parsing, octree-based CFD-to-FEA field mapping for fluid–structure interaction.
TCAA — aeroacoustics: FW–H / Farassat 1A implemented as custom OpenFOAM classes, multithreaded observer evaluation, FFT-based spectra and octave-band SPL.
TBASE — simulation database and server process: SQLite with RAII transactions and nested savepoints, binary mesh serialization, cross-platform named-pipe IPC to the ParaView GUI.
TMESH — FEA meshing: NetGen and Gmsh behind one interface, mesh/CAD I/O (VOL, MSH, INP, STEP via OpenCASCADE).
TCFD / TOPT — OpenFOAM solver extensions and optimization workflows (DIRECT, EGO).
Build and CI — authored the GitLab CI pipeline and CTest unit-test suites (including headless Qt tests) with clang-format checks; Linux/Windows installers with MinGW-w64 cross-builds.

charles-mff-research.description: Computational biophysics and membrane modelling in the group of Christoph Allolio: continuum modelling of lipid membranes.
highlights: Conducted molecular dynamics simulations of lipid membranes (GROMACS).
Implemented a continuum mechanics solver in C++ for membrane remodelling.
